list.name: twin
list.label: Twin
list.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "telemetry") |> keep(columns: ["twin_id"]) |> distinct(column: "twin_id")

list.name: field
list.label: Field
list.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "telemetry" and r["twin_id"] == "${twin}" and r["_field"] != "anomaly") |> keep(columns: ["_field"]) |> distinct(column: "_field")

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "telemetry" and r["twin_id"] == "${twin}" and r["_field"] == "${field}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
